_note: Raid planner: damage dealt to structures, hand-collected. Not extracted.
Each damage value = what ONE FULL USE of the weapon actually deals to the structure
in game, with every multiplier already baked in (material weakness, heat damage, etc.).
Measure it, never compute it. null = not measured yet.
A full use is: one charge/rocket/grenade for munitions (they fire once), and the whole
durability of one crafted tool for tools with durability (pickaxe, salvaged icepick...) —
i.e. for tools the value already covers all N hits of the crafted item, do NOT multiply
by anything. The flamethrower is measured per unit of low grade fuel spent.
Keys are Rust shortnames so crafting cost and workbench tier join against
data/recipes.json (checked by tools/audit-raid-db.mjs). Ammo-based weapons are keyed
by the consumable, not the launcher: ammo.rocket.basic, not rocket.launcher.
Side-sensitive weapons may add an optional third segment to a damage key:
<block>.<grade>.<side> with side = soft|hard (e.g. wall.stone.soft). Use it ONLY
when the damage actually depends on the face hit (melee tools); side-independent
weapons (C4, rockets) keep the neutral <block>.<grade> key. Side variants exist only
in this file — raid-structures.json never has per-side entries, maxHp is the same.
Structure keys must exist in data/raid-structures.json. Building blocks use the
synthetic <block>.<grade> keys defined there.
costItem: set when the per-use cost is a different item's recipe (the flamethrower
burns lowgradefuel). Defaults to the weapon's own shortname.
recipeOverride: only for weapons with no recipe at all in recipes.json (found-only
items). Provides workbench (0-3, or null for not craftable) and ingredients.
Fill _patch with the game version the numbers were measured on.
